final: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region_name, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region_name, AVG(account_average) AS region_average FROM account_averages GROUP BY region_name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(region_average) AS value FROM region_averages), kept_regions AS (SELECT r.region_name, r.region_average, r.region_average - o.value AS difference FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.value IS NOT NULL AND r.region_average > o.value), final_average AS (SELECT AVG(region_average) AS value FROM kept_regions) SELECT k.region_name, k.region_average, k.difference, k.region_average / f.value FROM kept_regions AS k CROSS JOIN final_average AS f WHERE f.value IS NOT NULL
